newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,163 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,163 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 3,163 contracts compared with 4,328 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 425 wheat, 1,852 corn, 643 soybean, 111 soymeal, 69 soyoil, two oat, four wheat calls, 17 corn calls, 23 soybean calls and 17 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat 1/2 to 3-1/2 cents lower, corn was three to 4-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were four to 14 cents lower.
